### Part A

Building Data Frame

```{r}
data = data.frame(
  outcome = c(6, 7, 8, 8, 9, 10,
              8, 9, 10, 10, 11, 12,
              12, 13, 14, 14, 15, 16),
  group = factor(rep(c("A", "B", "C"), each = 6))
)
```

ANOVA

```{r}
fit = aov(outcome ~ group, data = data)
print(summary(fit))
groups = split(data$outcome, data$group)
n = lengths(groups)
means = sapply(groups, mean)
grand = mean(data$outcome)
ssb = sum(n * (means - grand)^2)
N = sum(n)
k = length(n)
ssw = sum(residuals(fit)^2)
mse = ssw/(N-k)
print(c(SSB = ssb, SSW = ssw, MSE = mse))
```

### Part B

```{r}
pairs = combn(k, 2)
delta = means[pairs[2,]] - means[pairs[1,]]
names(delta) = c("B-A", "C-A", "C-B")
se = sqrt(mse*(1/n[pairs[1,]] + 1/n[pairs[2,]]))
stat = delta/se
raw = 2*pt(-abs(stat), N - k) 
adj = p.adjust(raw, method = 'bonferroni')
print(cbind(delta, stat, raw, adj))
```

### Part C

```{r}
tk = TukeyHSD(fit, 'group', conf.level = 0.95)$group
print(tk[c('B-A','C-A','C-B'), ])
```
